description_en: You can call this operation to create a tenant.
kebab_example: aliyun oceanbasepro create-tenant --tenant-name pay_online --cpu 2 --memory 10 --time-zone Asia/Shanghai --tenant-mode Oracle --charset utf8mb4 --instance-id ob317v4uif0000 --user-vpc-id vpc-bp1d2q3mhg9i23ofi0000 --user-vswitch-id vsw-bp11k1aypnzu1l3whi0000 --primary-zone cn-hangzhou-h --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTenant

parameters.help_en:
The name of the tenant.    
It must start with a letter or an underscore (), and contain 2 to 20 characters, which can be uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and underscores ().  It cannot be set to sys.
parameters.help_zh:
租户名称。
长度为 2~20 个字符，支持英文字母、数字和下划线，区分大小写，必须以字母或下划线开头。 不可设置为 sys
parameters.name: tenant_name

parameters.help_en:
The number of CPU cores of the tenant.
The CPU specification of a single tenant cannot exceed that of the corresponding cluster.
For example, if the specification of the cluster is 14 CPU cores and 70 GB of memory, the CPU specification of the tenant cannot exceed 14 cores.
parameters.help_zh:
租户的 CPU 大小，单位：核数（Cores）。
单个租户的 CPU 不能超过所属集群的规格。
例如：集群为 14C70GB，则 CPU 不超过 14C
parameters.name: cpu

parameters.help_en:
The memory size of the tenant, in GB.
The memory size of a single tenant cannot exceed that of the corresponding cluster.
For example, if the specification of the cluster is 14 CPU cores and 70 GB of memory, the memory size of the tenant cannot exceed 70 GB.
parameters.help_zh:
租户内存大小，单位 GB。
单个租户的内存不能超过所属集群的规格。
例如：集群为 14C70GB，则内存不超过 70GB
parameters.name: memory

parameters.help_en: The time zone of the tenant. For more information, see DescribeTimeZones (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/apsaradb-for-oceanbase/latest/api-oceanbasepro-2019-09-01-describetimezones)
parameters.help_zh: 租户所在时区。 详情参见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/410361.html
parameters.name: time_zone

parameters.help_en:
The tenant mode.    
Valid values: Oracle and MySQL.   
For more information, see DescribeInstanceTenantModes (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/apsaradb-for-oceanbase/latest/api-oceanbasepro-2019-09-01-describeinstancetenantmodes)
parameters.help_zh:
租户模式。
当前支持 Oracle 模式（Oracle）、MySQL 模式（MySQL）。  
详情参见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/410354.html
parameters.name: tenant_mode

parameters.help_en:
The character set.    
For more information, see DescribeCharset (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/apsaradb-for-oceanbase/latest/api-oceanbasepro-2019-09-01-describecharset)
parameters.name: charset

parameters.help_en: The ID of the OceanBase cluster.
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the VPC.   
 If no suitable VPC is available, create a VPC as prompted.   
For more information, see "What is a VPC".
parameters.help_zh:
专有网络（VPC） ID。  
 如无合适的 VPC，请根据页面提示创建一个 VPC。  
详情参见什么是专有网络
parameters.name: user_vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the vSwitch.    
If no suitable vSwitch is available, create a vSwitch as prompted.   
For more information, see Use a vSwitch.
parameters.help_zh:
虚拟交换机（VSwitch）ID。   
如无合适的 VSwitch，请根据页面提示创建一个。  
详情参见使用交换机
parameters.name: user_vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The primary zone of the tenant.    
It is one of the zones in which the cluster is deployed.
parameters.help_zh:
租户的主可用区。
其为集群部署可用区中的一个
parameters.name: primary_zone

parameters.help_en:
The number of resource distribution nodes in the tenant.    
The number is determined by the deployment mode of the cluster. If the cluster is deployed in 2-2-2 mode, the maximum number of resource distribution nodes is 2.
parameters.help_zh:
租户的资源分布节点数。
其与集群的部署模式相耦合，如集群模式为 2-2-2，则最后分布节点数最多为 2 个
parameters.name: unit_num

parameters.help_en:
Specifies to create a read-only zone. Separate the names of multiple zones with commas (,).
At present, this parameter is unavailable.>
parameters.help_zh:
创建只读副本的可用区，当传入多个可用区的时候，以逗号分隔。
<notice>此参数暂时不可用。></notice>
parameters.name: read_only_zone_list

parameters.help_en: The size of the log disk allocated to the tenant, in GB
parameters.help_zh: 租户的已分配日志盘大小，单位：GB
parameters.name: log_disk

parameters.help_zh: 创建租户时，初始化参数
parameters.name: create_params

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC owner
parameters.name: user_vpc_owner_id
